issues.description: Array helper API is inconsistent across repositories: the template defines ArrayHelpers.appendElement(T[], T), but template Stock.java calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...), and the solution implements/uses addElementToArray(...) instead. As provided, the template does not compile and students cannot follow the intended use of ArrayHelpers.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent: either rename template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...), or change all call sites in template/solution (e.g., Stock.addToStockIngredients and SealSaloon) to use appendElement(...). Optionally keep both names by adding a delegating wrapper to preserve backward compatibility.

issues.description: SealSaloon.stock static-ness is contradictory in the specification: the problem statement explicitly requires the Stock attribute 'stock' to be static (shared across instances), but the UML association depicts 'stock' as an instance attribute (not marked static). This creates ambiguity about whether stock should be per-saloon or shared globally.
issues.suggestedFix: Align UML and text: mark stock as static in the UML (e.g., underline or {static}) and keep acceptSupplyDelivery/calculateTotalPrice static; or, if stock should be instance-level, remove the static requirement from the text and make those methods instance methods.
